verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a host-side view of currently connected guests or a control to disconnect or revoke a device. The nearest items are adjacent features: per-app permissions for connected guests (parsec-docs-13), audit logs via the Teams API, and time-limited guest access credits. None of these is a live connection list or a kick/revoke action, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, the host shows who is connected right now, and I can disconnect or revoke a device from the host
